acceptanceCriteria: Tools under GOROOT and the RSpec toolchain run from verified private copies, or are refused.
A swap test between digest check and exec fails before the fix and passes after.
body: Suspected defect, not confirmed. Predecessor: V1-2029 (BBF-V0-214 fixed only the Go driver TOCTOU by running a private copy of verified bytes). Tools under GOROOT and the RSpec toolchain still run in place after their digest check, so a swap between check and exec is still possible. Versions: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 698); corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.698. Source: lane cce-b-1021, PR beamfall/corvint#1418, 2026-10-21.
title: Suspected: GOROOT tools and RSpec toolchain still run in place after digest check (residual of V1-2029)
